sources.text: i have since observed that he was only a degree worse than many other clerical readers and that a strange and delightfully mistaken notion seems prevalent that the bible must be read in a dreary and unnatural tone of voice
for i was fast lapsing into one of the moods which my little mother used to call my morbid streaks
